<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Opposition strategy:</strong> The INDIA bloc is coordinating legal and political protests against the Election Commission, even as AAP leader Sanjay Singh clarifies that his party remains outside the formal coalition.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxPLW1QdlhQV0w1dHFHY0d6cElYZU5UWDJNUnlJYmhJcDZ0eUJpeW1WeFhzR3ZIZ3l6NWhVbWlMQUtpWTZpMjFDVEhfTzkzRGdDWjNkSE9iY1l0akNabjNFbmtzNHZwNzVyTUNPdTkxTHVUVEVMelVsc1NWNGItUjQ5cHc2bEcxSm8?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral integrity:</strong> The High Court has demanded an explanation from the Election Commission regarding the unexplained removal of voters from electoral rolls in Goa.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
